page.overview:
Who is Zed?

Zed is an Alpha Team Mission Deep Freeze minifigure introduced in 2005.

Zed wears a black snowsuit with silver printed lines, multiple silver straps with small blue buttons, and a unique elliptical insignia on the chest; aside from the insignia, this is a color variant of Flex and Charge's uniforms. Unlike other Mission Deep Freeze minifigures, both of his arms and hands are bright yellow. His face bears a confident smirk, a blue soul patch, and blue/black gradient hair with a yellow checkerboard pattern on the right side.

In his brief cameo in Prehistoric Creatures Vs. Team Titan XP, Zed's torso is bright yellow.

Zed is an Alpha Team special agent. At the end of Prehistoric Creatures Vs. Team Titan XP, Zed is on a warm and sunny beach when he receives Dash Justice's emergency beacon. He pilots the Blizzard Blaster, which is equipped with special time tech to protect it from Ogel's time freeze wave. He arrives at Ogel's Mountain Fortress and uses a thermo ray to melt the ice and rescue his fellow Alpha Team agents. He battles Ogel's Scorpion Orb Launcher.
